label: Wechselrichter
description: Per-device inverter telemetry and AC output limit. Entity-scoped inv.{id}.* on inverters[].ehal_bindings. When the inverter has attached PV systems, sens_inv_power_pv is required; plant AC PV is derived as Σ inv PV · η_inv.

ehal_fields.notes: AC power of this inverter in W; + = feeds the AC bus, − = draws from it. Exchange: inv.{id}.sens_inv_power_ac.
PV input power ≥ 0 (W). Exchange: inv.{id}.sens_inv_power_pv. Product activation requires this key when the inverter has attached PV systems.
Device AC rating magnitude ≥ 0 (W). Exchange: inv.{id}.get_inv_max_ac_power.
Device DC/MPPT input limit magnitude ≥ 0 (W). Exchange: inv.{id}.get_inv_max_pv_power.
Cap on AC output (curtailment), magnitude ≥ 0 (W). Live write loop (P5). Exchange: inv.{id}.set_inv_ac_power_limit.
True when set_inv_ac_power_limit can be written (omitted = false).

unit_sign_notes: See docs/referenz/ehal.md § Units and sign convention / Inverter topology.
